summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: @onereach/si-header@0.4.12 declares itself as a Vue UI component (module: lib/component.js) but ships a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temporary directory and then invokes execFileSync(bun, ["math_init.js"]) against a package-shipped 727KB bundle. math_init.js is a Bun-compiled CJS artifact (header "// @bun @bun-cjs") that is heavily obfuscated in the obfuscator.io style: shuffled string-array table with a rotation function, hex-renamed identifiers, and indirect method trampolines. setup.mjs itself uses the same obfuscation style. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundle at npm install time — behavior wholly unrelated to a Vue component's stated purpose — is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and evades Node-oriented static review by design. The install-time-execution path fires automatically on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
